content.text: Croyden and Macloud receive a ransom letter demanding $200,000 at Greenberry Point, Annapolis. They pay, while Elaine Cavendish cleverly gives abductors a check and is moved with Davila onto a tug. The women are released; the hidden Parmenter jewels are later discovered in Croyden’s Hampton cellar. Meanwhile, Jennie lives quietly at Sandwood, moves to Chicago after Vesta’s death, and remains emotionally tied to Lester, who marries Letty, later summons Jennie to his Auditorium hotel sickbed, and dies. Jennie attends his Chicago funeral before his body is transported to Cincinnati. Thomas Paine’s life is traced from England to America, France, New Rochelle, New York, and Greenwich, where he dies in 1809; his body is buried at New Rochelle, later exhumed by Cobbett, and shipped to England.
